name: What factors influence the cost of new drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of new drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new drywall installation is influenced by several key factors. These include the total square footage of the area, the type of drywall selected (e.g., standard, moisture-resistant, fire-rated), the complexity of the job (e.g., high ceilings, many corners, arches), and the amount of finishing required (e.g., smooth finish vs. textured). Additional costs may arise from demolition of existing walls, insulation upgrades, or specialized framing adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include square footage, drywall type, job complexity, finishing level, and potential demolition or framing adjustments.
